title: [Snyk] SNYK-PYTHON-LUPA-15954200 in lupa@2.6
description:
## Arbitrary Code Injection

**Severity:** high
**Package:** lupa@2.6
**File:** `pyproject.toml`

**CVSS Score:** 7.9  
**Exploit Maturity:** proof-of-concept  
**Snyk Priority Score:** 788/1000

### CVEs
- [CVE-2026-34444](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-34444)

**Fix:** Upgrade `lupa` to version 2.7 or later.

### Details
## Overview
[lupa](https://pypi.org/project/lupa) is a Python wrapper around Lua and LuaJIT

Affected versions of this package are vulnerable to Arbitrary Code Injection incomplete enforcement of the `attribute_filter` in the `getattr` and `setattr` built-in functions. An attacker can execute arbitrary commands in the host environment by bypassing attribute access restrictions through built-in functions when untrusted Lua code is allowed to access Python builtins.
## Remediation
Upgrade `lupa` to version 2.7 or higher.
